contests.title: Adams-Friendship Area School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote: BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the Adams-Friendship Area School District, Adams County, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $2,750,000 per year for 4 years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of maintaining current 4K-5th grade and 6th-8th grade class sizes, existing career and technical education programming, co-curricular experiences, and operational costs associated with maintaining school buildings.

contests.title: Cashton School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote: Be it resolved by the School Board of the School District of Cashton, Monroe, Vernon, and La Crosse Counties, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.9 Wisconsin Statutes, by $450,000 per year for three years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2029-2030 school year, for non-recurring purposes of operational and maintenance expenses.

contests.title: De Soto Area School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote:
BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the De Soto Area School District, Vernon
and Crawford Counties, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be
authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by
$500,000 for the 2026-2027 school year, by $1,400,000 for the 2027-2028 school year and by
$1,700,000 for the 2028-2029 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of maintaining
facilities, instructional programs, student services and updating security and network technology
systems.

contests.title: Iola-Scandinavia School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote: BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the School District of Iola-Scandinavia, Waupaca and Portage Counties, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,200,000 for the 2026-2027 school year, and by $1,500,000 per year for three years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2029-2030 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of sustaining educational programming, student opportunities and operations.

contests.title: Ladysmith School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote:
BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the School District of Ladysmith, Rusk
County, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to
exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $950,000 per year
for five years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2031-2032 school
year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of maintaining current educational programs, student
services, and general maintenance.

contests.title: Little Chute Area School District — Question 2 — School improvement bonds

provenance.quote:
BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the Little Chute Area School District,
Outagamie County, Wisconsin that there shall be issued pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin
Statutes, general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $1,950,000 for the public purpose
of paying the cost of a school facility improvement project consisting of: district building
infrastructure and capital maintenance improvements, including roof repairs and replacement at
all school buildings, asbestos abatement and related renovations at the High School, and air
conditioning replacement at the Elementary School; and acquisition of furnishings, fixtures and
equipment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise $2.75 million a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for four school years, from 2027–28 through 2030–31. It would pay to maintain current class sizes in four-year-old kindergarten through eighth grade, existing career and technical education programs, co-curricular activities, and school-building operations. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $450,000 a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for three school years, from 2027–28 through 2029–30, for operations and maintenance. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise money above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for three school years: $500,000 in 2026–27, $1.4 million in 2027–28, and $1.7 million in 2028–29. It would pay for facilities, instructional programs, student services, and updates to security and network technology. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $400,000 a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for two school years, 2026–27 and 2027–28, for operations and maintenance. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise money above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for four school years: $1.2 million in 2026–27 and $1.5 million a year from 2027–28 through 2029–30. It would pay for educational programs, student opportunities, and operations. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $950,000 a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for five school years, from 2027–28 through 2031–32. It would pay to maintain current educational programs, student services, and general maintenance. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to borrow up to $1.95 million through general obligation bonds for building infrastructure and maintenance projects. These include roof repairs and replacements at all school buildings, asbestos removal and related renovations at the high school, replacement of elementary-school air conditioning, and furnishings, fixtures and equipment.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve borrowing up to $1.95 million for these projects.
